observations.why: The matched conditional framing supplies a practical argument for rehearsal by linking unrehearsed capability to absent capability.
The session presents a monthly cadence as an agreed process, but the split footing makes this a reported rendering of the session principal's stance.
The ownership designation invokes role-based authority and responsibility; the principal is Quinton Fairweather himself despite the labeled delivery.
